meta.name: flowio
meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取、检查和写入流式细胞术FCS文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要处理FCS格式的流式细胞术数据文件
copy.tagline_en: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry FCS files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work with FCS files from flow cytometry experiments

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能解析流式细胞术标准（FCS）文件（v2.0-3.1），读取元数据和通道信息，提取事件为NumPy数组，创建新FCS文件，并导出为CSV或DataFrame。
howto.when: 当你要求处理FCS文件、读取流式数据、提取事件、转换格式或创建新FCS文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我读取这个FCS文件，显示通道名称和事件数。
say.note: 调用FlowData读取文件并输出基本属性。

say.text: 创建一个新的FCS文件，包含FSC、SSC和FL1三个通道。
say.note: 使用create_fcs函数，需提供NumPy数组和通道名。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can parse FCS files (v2.0-3.1), read metadata and channel info, extract events as NumPy arrays, create new FCS files, and export to CSV or DataFrame.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to process FCS files, read flow cytometry data, extract events, convert formats, or create new FCS files.

say_en.text: Read this FCS file and show channel names and event count.
say_en.note: Calls FlowData to read file and output basic properties.

say_en.text: Export the data from events.fcs to CSV format.
say_en.note: Uses FlowData to convert to DataFrame and save CSV.

say_en.text: Create a new FCS file with FSC, SSC, and FL1 channels.
say_en.note: Uses create_fcs with a NumPy array and channel names.
